motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of February 10, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the date correction…
motions.motion: Commissioner Lane moved to approve the minutes of February 10, 2026, Planning Commission meeting with the date correction in the footer. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed with 3 in favor and one abstention.
motions.headline: February 10 minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the minutes of its February 10, 2026 meeting after fixing a wrong date in the page footer.
motions.impact: Fixing a typo in the meeting record changes nothing for anyone outside the commission.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Williams Development Agreement. Commission…
motions.motion: Commissioner Hess moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Williams Development Agreement. Commissioner DeCoursey seconded the motion.
motions.outcome: passed with 3 in favor and 1 against.
motions.headline: Williams development agreement sent to council
motions.summary: The commission recommended that the City Council approve the Williams Development Agreement.
motions.impact: Nothing takes effect yet: the council makes the final call later. The motion does not say where the land is or what would be built there.
